scene.note: The rides screen decides for each ride what to say, and leaves out what does not apply.

steps.note: Each ride in the rota says how many seats are left.
The row picks its words from that number, and its colour with them.
A family at the stop can tell at a glance which rides are full.
Some trams have a step-free door, some do not.
The row adds the mark only for the trams that have one.
Nobody plans a trip around a door that is not there.
Each ride has a number of wheelchair spaces, sometimes none.
The row shows the spaces when there are some, and nothing otherwise.
No row has a number left on it that means nothing.
Late in the day, the last ride has gone and the list is empty.
The list notices before drawing anything.
The screen says plainly that the rides are over.
Some days Wilf writes a notice; most days he leaves it empty.
The notice is handed whatever he wrote.
It shows his words, or on a quiet day nothing at all.
